title: Finding Evaluation v1
description:
Per-hunt automatic finding-evaluation verdict (bin/lab-verify-findings, lib/findingeval.py).

Every completed hunt is evaluated before any finding reaches the captain: each
finding-candidate (schema security-lab/finding-candidate/v1) is run through the
deterministic gates — scope (lab-scope semantics via the shared labutil scope
primitives), evidence shape (request/response pairs, callback records, canary
values — the oracles from lib/verification.py), the verification oracle itself
(outcome must be verified), and the hypothesis ledger (lib/hypothesis.py
derived status). Findings that pass ALL gates are tagged `candidate`; findings
that fail any gate are tagged `noisy` with the failing oracle and reason, and
the reason is recorded into the program playbook (bin/lab-hunt-lesson) so the
dead end is never re-found.

Only candidates surface to the captain. The verdict file is written to
<lab>/findings/eval/<hunt-id>.json (+ .md) by the CLI.

Model-authored prose can never produce verdict=candidate — only the
deterministic gates can.

hunt_id.description:
Hunt identifier (defaults to the workspace name). Used as the verdict
file stem: findings/eval/<hunt-id>.json.

workspace.description:
Workspace directory the findings were evaluated from (as supplied to
the CLI).

engagement.description: Engagement name the findings belong to (matches engagements/<name>.yaml).

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the evaluation ran.

findings.description: Per-finding verdicts, one per evaluated finding-candidate.

target.description: The scoped target the finding applies to.

vuln_class.description: Hypothesized vulnerability class (sqli, xss, idor, auth-bypass, ...).

verdict.description:
candidate = passed all gates (surfaces to the captain). noisy = failed
at least one gate (recorded as a dead-end lesson, never re-found).

gates.description:
The deterministic gates run, in order: scope, evidence_shape,
oracle, hypothesis_ledger. Each records pass/fail + detail.

detail.description: Deterministic reason for the gate result.

oracle.description:
For the oracle gate: which verification oracle ran
(authorization|business_logic|sha256_canary|oob_callback).

outcome.description:
For the oracle gate: the verification outcome
(verified|disproved|insufficient_evidence).

status.description:
For the hypothesis_ledger gate: the derived status
(confirmed|testing|disconfirmed|contradictory|unverified|superseded).

failing_oracle.description: The first gate that failed (null when verdict=candidate).

reason.description: One-line deterministic reason for the verdict.

lesson_recorded.description:
True when a dead-end lesson was recorded to the program playbook for a
noisy finding (best-effort; false when the program slug was empty or the
playbook write failed).

candidates.description: Findings that passed all gates (surface to the captain).

noisy.description: Findings that failed at least one gate (recorded as dead ends).

gates.name: oracle
gates.detail: cross-actor response contained victim marker, control response did not, ownership verified
